meta.name: Ren 表情プロンプト
meta.description: 諏訪野レン（オリジナルキャラクター）用の表情差分プロンプト集。Whisk の画像生成（参照画像アップロード→image-to-image モデル化）での利用を想定。
meta.author: GitHub Copilot
meta.usage_notes: まずは reference_fullbody の `combined_prompt` を試し、必要に応じて `positives` を組み合わせてください。ネガティブトークンは必ず含めてください。服装の被りを避けるため、他キャラの識別的なアクセント（例: Ai のシアンライン、タケシのネオンライム、ユズのパステルリボン）の使用を禁止しています。
meta.image_model_usage: Upload the reference image at `doc/02_Characters/images/Ren/ren.png` to Whisk, create/use an image model for Ren, and use image-to-image generation where possible.

color_preservation.instruction: Preserve reference image color balance; do NOT add cyan/neon-lime/pastel accents. Preserve a pale/ashen but detailed skin tone (slightly cool, not washed-out) consistent with Ren's setting; maintain dark neutral palette for clothing and cobalt as small terminal/device accent only.

pose_preservation.instruction: Preserve reference head pose and camera angle — do NOT change face orientation, rotation, or head tilt. Keep short spiky hair and thin lanky silhouette as in reference. Glasses must remain present and correctly placed.

accessory_preservation.instruction: Keep black rim glasses always present. Do NOT add ribbons, jewelry, or bright accessories. Small cobalt device glow (terminal screen/cable) is allowed as accent only.

cutout_defaults.note_jp: 切り抜き用の白いストローク（被写体の輪郭に沿うアウトライン、推奨 18–24px）を必ず付与してください。被写体+ストロークが画像端から24px以上余裕を持つことを確認してください。透過ではなく白背景で出力してください。画像の四隅に四角い白い枠（矩形の外枠）を追加しないでください。外周の矩形枠ではなく、被写体の輪郭に沿うストロークのみを付与してください.

expressions.combined_prompt: Ren (Suwano Ren), single character only (solo), full-body anime character, centered, portrait/vertical composition (tall), standing pose with composed cold stance, slim lanky build (approx 170cm), short intentionally spiked black hair, black rim glasses present, pronounced dark under-eye circles visible under glasses, pale slightly ashen skin tone (slightly cool but not washed-out), long thin hands and elegant fingers, clothing: tailored long black coat (NO hood) + black turtleneck, dark trousers (no bright patterns), enforce dark neutral palette (Primary #0c1d36, Secondary #4a6074), **Accent:** small cobalt glow #0077FF only on a device screen or thin cable (do NOT use as clothing trim or large accessory), clean lineart, ultra-detailed, crisp silhouette, full-body visible (head-to-toe), studio lighting with cold cyan rim/highlight (subtle) to emphasize device glow, plain soft mid-gray background, include a thick white silhouette stroke (outline) 18–24px that follows the subject's silhouette (do NOT add a rectangular outer border or corner frame); Do NOT add pastel colors, neon-lime accents, cyan clothing trims, or ribbons (these would create clothing overlap with other characters); ensure the subject+stroke has at least a 24px margin to the image edge; no transparent background; preserve pale ashen skin detail and realistic proportions; do NOT blur or pixelate the face; Do NOT generate multiple people, duplicates, clones, or extra characters; Use portrait orientation (vertical) — resolution 2048x3072 (tall) and compose subject centrally; ensure clear head-to-toe visibility.
positives: tailored long black coat (no hood) + black turtleneck
expressions.notes_jp: レンの全身リファレンス用。**目的:** 冷静で支配的な『管理者』の立ち絵を作ること。服装の被りを避けるため、シアン／ネオンライム／パステル等の他キャラ固有アクセントは一切使用しないでください。フードは存在しないデザイン（被らせない）を厳守し、テーラードロングコート＋タートルネックなどフードのない上着を推奨します。肌は蒼白寄りだが、ディテールは保持してください。まずは text2img で複数枚生成し、好みの頭身と陰影を決めた後に img2img（denoising_strength 0.30–0.45）で表情差分を作成してください。シード固定で再現性を確保してください.

expressions.combined_prompt: Use reference image (init) for pose/color. Ren, anime-style portrait, calm neutral expression, cold unreadable eyes behind black rim glasses, preserve pale ashen skin and under-eye circles, keep parka hood DOWN and glasses present, small cobalt device glow allowed (screen/cable only), plain mid-gray background, thick white silhouette stroke (18-24px) following subject silhouette (not a rectangular border); ensure subject+stroke has at least a 24px margin to image edge; place small black registration mark (8x8px) outside the stroke at bottom-right; high detail, crisp silhouette, preserve head pose (do NOT change face orientation or head tilt)
expressions.notes_jp: img2img 用テンプレート。init_image に全身リファレンスを指定し、denoising_strength ≒ 0.30–0.45 を推奨。

expressions.combined_prompt: Use reference image (init) for pose/color. Ren, tired expression with heavy under-eye shadows, slightly sunken cheeks, faint mouth downturn, glasses present, pale ashen skin, subtle cobalt reflection in eyes, soft cool studio lighting, plain mid-gray background, include thick white silhouette stroke (18-24px) following subject silhouette (not a rectangular border); ensure subject+stroke has at least a 24px margin to image edge; place small black registration mark (8x8px) outside stroke at bottom-right; high detail
expressions.notes_jp: 泣きや衰弱ではなく、慢性疲労の表現を優先してください。

expressions.combined_prompt: Use reference image (init) for pose/color. Ren, subtle smirk or sardonic half-smile, eyes slightly narrowed, glasses present, preserve pale skin and under-eye circles, maintain dark palette and cobalt device glow only as small accent, plain mid-gray background, include thick white silhouette stroke (18-24px) following subject silhouette (not a rectangular border); ensure subject+stroke has at least a 24px margin to image edge; place small black registration mark (8x8px) outside stroke at bottom-right; high detail
expressions.notes_jp: img2img 用微妙な表情差分。目元の鋭さを強調してください。
